seoTitle: How to Create a T-Shirt Design in Canva Easily
metaDescription: Design a print-ready T-shirt graphic in Canva with the right canvas size, font effects, and transparent PNG export for apparel printing.
intro: Building custom apparel graphics from scratch is achievable in Canva without any prior design experience. This guide covers setting up the right canvas dimensions, combining fonts with graphics, testing your design on a mockup, and exporting a high-resolution transparent PNG ready for printing.

steps.heading: Set up the T-shirt canvas
steps.body: Launch a project using an optimized grid sized for T-shirt design work.

steps.heading: Choose a template or start from scratch
steps.body: Pick a starter template for guidance, or begin with a blank canvas for full creative freedom.

steps.heading: Add graphics and illustrations
steps.body: Browse the elements marketplace for high-quality illustrations and vector graphics to build your design.

steps.heading: Apply text effects and typography
steps.body: Use font effects and text curves to create eye-catching typography that fits your design concept.

steps.heading: Preview with Smart Mockups
steps.body: Use the built-in Smart Mockups tool to see how your graphic looks on an actual shirt before finalizing.

steps.heading: Export as a transparent PNG
steps.body: Configure your export settings for a high-resolution PNG with a transparent background suitable for printing.

faq.question: What file format do I need for printing a T-shirt?
faq.answer: A high-resolution PNG with a transparent background is the recommended format for most print-on-demand and apparel printing services.

faq.question: Can I see how my design looks on a real shirt before printing?
faq.answer: Yes, Canva's Smart Mockups tool lets you preview your graphic on clothing models before you export or print.

faq.question: Do I need design experience to create a T-shirt graphic?
faq.answer: No, Canva's templates and drag-and-drop elements make it possible to build a professional design without prior graphic design skills.

faq.question: Where can I find graphics for my T-shirt design?
faq.answer: Canva's elements marketplace includes a wide range of illustrations and vector graphics you can browse and add to your canvas.
